title: Multilayered specificity of transcription factor binding at cytokine promoters
authors: Anna Lagani; Ryan Lane; Yunwei Lu; Sakshi Shah; Zhaorong Li; Luis Soto-Ugaldi; Mahir Patel; Cosmin Ciausu; Matias Alejandro Paz; Juan I. Fuxman Bass
one_liner_zh: 该文通过酵母单杂交系统研究细胞因子启动子上TF-DNA结合的多层特异性，但主要依赖实验方法，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Transcription factors (TFs) regulate gene expression through sequence-specific DNA binding, and their genomic occupancy is further influenced by TF expression, activation state, and protein-protein interactions. How these mechanisms determine context-specific gene regulation remains incompletely understood, particularly for tightly controlled immune genes such as cytokines. Here, we use paired yeast one-hybrid (pY1H) assays to systematically examine DNA binding of 236 TFs and 392 TF-pairs across 106 cytokine gene promoters. Of the 1,619 TF-promoter interactions identified, 555 required TF cooperativity and 410 were antagonized by at least one TF partner, suggesting that TF-DNA binding is highly dependent on TF partners. Usage of different partners can drastically alter a TF’s target repertoire and may result in the recruitment of different transcriptional cofactors. Integration with existing data on TF expression and activation further showed that cooperativity and antagonism provide additional, underappreciated layers of DNA-binding specificity.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）通过序列特异性DNA结合调控基因表达，其基因组占据进一步受TF表达、激活状态及蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的影响。这些机制如何决定上下文特异性基因调控仍未完全阐明，尤其是对于如细胞因子等受到严格调控的免疫基因。在此，我们使用配对酵母单杂交（pY1H）测定法，系统检测了106个细胞因子基因启动子中236个TFs和392个TF对的DNA结合情况。在鉴定出的1,619个TF-启动子相互作用中，555个需要TF协同性，410个被至少一个TF伙伴拮抗，表明TF-DNA结合高度依赖于TF伙伴。使用不同伙伴可显著改变TF的靶标库，并可能导致招募不同的转录共因子。与现有TF表达和激活数据的整合进一步表明，协同性和拮抗性提供了额外且未被充分认识的DNA结合特异性层次。
